test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: A milkman bought 45 litres of milk and mixed 15 litres of water in it. If the price per litre of the mixture becomes ₹ 50, then what is the cost price of the milk per litre? (water is available free of cost)
solution:
**Given**

Milk = 45 liters

Water = 15 liters (free)

Mixture price = ₹50 per liter

**Formula used:**

Cost of pure milk = (Cost of mixture ×Volume of mixture)/Volume of milk

**Solution:**

⇒ Cost of milk per liter = ₹50 × [(45 liters + 15 litres)/ (45 liters)] = ₹ 66(2)/(3)

**Therefore, the cost price of milk per liter is approximately ₹** 66(2)/(3)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

By mixture allegation method

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7db17c34729aa4f16b38fb2e5c0b077201841d9928042c244937b459aae7699.png] 

Let the cost price of milk be 'x'

⇒ x - 50 = 50/3

⇒ x = (50/3) + 50 = 200/3 = Rs. 66(2/3)
